name: Retatrutide
short: Triple-receptor research peptide targeting GLP-1, GIP and glucagon receptor signaling.
detail: Retatrutide is a synthetic peptide investigated for its activity at three metabolic receptors. Its research profile supports studies of receptor signaling and energy regulation. Findings from other formulations or clinical studies do not establish the performance of a COVA research vial.
spec: Reta family requested: 5, 10, 20, 40 and 60 mg nominal vial variants. Quote only the variant supported by the matching lot records.
headline: Weight & glucose pathways
description: Investigational triple GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist. Human trials evaluate weight management and glucose control.

name: Tirzepatide
short: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist for metabolic signaling research.
detail: Tirzepatide is a synthetic peptide that engages both GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Researchers study these pathways in glucose regulation and metabolic biology. COVA research material is distinct from approved prescription products containing this molecule.
spec: Confirm nominal vial content, chemical form and lot-specific documentation in the quotation.
headline: Appetite & glucose signaling
description: Dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor activity. Approved prescription formulations have clinical evidence for defined metabolic indications; formulation matters.

name: Semaglutide
short: GLP-1 receptor agonist used in studies of incretin signaling and metabolic regulation.
detail: Semaglutide is a modified GLP-1 analogue with an established role in receptor research. It allows investigation of incretin-related cellular pathways. The existence of approved medicines does not confer approval or clinical suitability on research inventory.
spec: Confirm nominal vial content and chemical form against the specific product and laboratory report.
headline: Appetite & metabolic regulation
description: GLP-1 receptor activity is associated with appetite and glucose regulation in clinical studies of approved prescription formulations.

name: Wolverine
short: COVA research blend listing associated with BPC-157 and TB-500. Exact composition accompanies the quote.
detail: Wolverine is a commercial blend name rather than a standardized scientific identity. Evaluate the component identities, their individual quantities and the analytical scope together. Results for an individual component do not establish the properties of a finished blend.
spec: Confirm BPC-157 and TB-500 identities, each amount, blend ratio and matching finished-blend testing. Do not infer the formula from its name.
source: COVA catalog handoff and recovered product brief; no finished-blend evidence supplied.
headline: A focus on connective tissue
description: A BPC-157 and TB-500 collection concept. Component studies explore tissue-repair pathways; the written formula defines the finished blend.

name: GLOW
short: Multi-component research blend offered under the GLOW catalog name. Request the full formulation.
detail: GLOW identifies a proposed blend in the COVA collection. Its scientific description depends on the actual ingredients and their amounts. Review the written formulation and finished-blend documentation before selecting it for a research project.
spec: Obtain the exact ingredient list, each nominal amount and lot-matched blend report. No formula or synergy claim is assumed.
headline: An interest in skin & recovery
description: A multi-peptide collection concept. Request the exact composition and individual amounts to understand its intended focus.

name: KLOW
short: Custom research blend listing. The written formulation defines its ingredients and research scope.
detail: KLOW is a catalog trade name with no universal ingredient definition. COVA can quote the specific formulation once its composition is documented. Assess its component identities and finished-blend analytical results rather than attributing unverified effects to the name.
spec: Request the exact formulation, each component amount and matching finished-blend documentation with the written quote.
headline: A considered combination
description: A custom blend concept. Its potential applications depend on the confirmed ingredients, amounts and finished-blend documentation.

name: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin
short: Paired research compounds for investigation of GHRH-related and ghrelin-receptor signaling.
detail: This listing pairs a GHRH-related compound with ipamorelin, a growth hormone secretagogue. The CJC designation needs particular care because products sold with and without DAC differ. Research on a named ingredient does not establish a finished blend's efficacy or safety.
spec: Confirm whether the CJC component is DAC-bearing CJC-1295 or the no-DAC modified GRF analogue. Record each amount and test the actual blend.
headline: Growth-hormone signaling
description: A paired approach to GHRH-related and ghrelin-receptor pathways. Confirm the CJC identity and DAC status in the formulation.

name: Sermorelin
short: GHRH(1-29) analogue for research into growth hormone-releasing hormone signaling.
detail: Sermorelin corresponds to the biologically active amino-terminal segment of growth hormone-releasing hormone. Its molecular identity makes it relevant to endocrine receptor research. Product selection should distinguish this molecule from longer or otherwise modified GHRH analogues.
spec: Confirm chemical form, nominal vial content and identity documentation for the quoted lot.
headline: The growth-hormone axis
description: A GHRH analogue studied for stimulation of growth-hormone release. Applications depend on the formulation and clinical context.

name: Tesamorelin
short: Modified growth hormone-releasing hormone analogue for endocrine pathway research.
detail: Tesamorelin is a synthetic GHRH analogue with structural differences from sermorelin. Researchers investigate GHRH receptor activity and related endocrine signaling. COVA research inventory is not presented as equivalent to an authorized tesamorelin medicine.
spec: Confirm chemical form, nominal vial content and the report associated with the offered lot.
headline: Body-composition pathways
description: A GHRH analogue. A prescription formulation has a specific indication for excess abdominal fat in adults with HIV-associated lipodystrophy.

name: MOTS-c
short: Mitochondrial-derived peptide studied in cellular metabolic adaptation and stress responses.
detail: MOTS-c is a short mitochondrial-derived peptide investigated in cell and animal models of metabolic regulation. Published work examines interactions among glucose metabolism, mitochondrial function and stress adaptation. These research observations do not establish human performance or longevity benefits.
spec: Request exact identity, nominal vial content and lot-specific analytical documentation.
headline: Metabolic resilience
description: A mitochondrial-derived peptide. Cell and animal studies examine metabolic adaptation, insulin sensitivity and physical capacity.

name: DSIP
short: Delta sleep-inducing peptide, a nonapeptide investigated in experimental sleep and neural signaling research.
detail: DSIP takes its name from early experimental studies of sleep-related activity. Subsequent research has explored its physiological and electrophysiological effects. Its name should not be interpreted as a guarantee of sleep improvement or as an indication for consumer use.
spec: Confirm the peptide identity and nominal vial content. Request the actual tested lot report.
headline: Sleep-related signaling
description: Delta sleep-inducing peptide has been investigated in experimental sleep and neural-signaling studies.

name: AOD-9604
short: Modified growth-hormone fragment investigated in preclinical lipid metabolism research.
detail: AOD-9604 derives from the C-terminal region of growth hormone. Preclinical studies have investigated lipid metabolism under experimental conditions. Those findings do not support a guaranteed fat-loss claim or establish clinical suitability for COVA research material.
spec: Confirm nominal content and exact sequence or molecular identity. Do not equate it with full-length growth hormone.
headline: Lipid-metabolism pathways
description: A modified growth-hormone fragment investigated in preclinical fat-metabolism studies; this describes a study focus.

name: NAD+
short: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a coenzyme used in cellular redox and enzyme research.
detail: NAD+ participates in oxidation-reduction reactions and numerous enzyme systems. It is a nucleotide coenzyme rather than a peptide. Listing it separately helps researchers distinguish its identity, analytical requirements and handling considerations from those of peptide products.
spec: Specify the oxidized NAD+ form, nominal content and applicable analytical method. Do not substitute NADH documentation.
headline: Cellular energy chemistry
description: An essential coenzyme involved in cellular redox reactions and enzyme activity. Its normal biological role is distinct from evidence for supplementation.

name: GHK-Cu
short: Copper-bound tripeptide studied in fibroblast activity and extracellular matrix biology.
detail: GHK-Cu combines the tripeptide glycyl-histidyl-lysine with copper. Cell studies have examined collagen-related processes and fibroblast responses. Research-vial supply does not by itself establish the safety, effectiveness or suitability of a finished skincare product.
spec: Distinguish copper-complexed GHK-Cu from copper-free GHK. Confirm content and analytical scope for the supplied form.
headline: Collagen & skin quality
description: Copper tripeptide literature explores fibroblast activity, collagen and extracellular-matrix biology, including topical skin studies.

name: BPC-157
short: Synthetic pentadecapeptide investigated in preclinical tissue-response and repair-pathway studies.
detail: BPC-157 is a synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide appearing in experimental research on tissue responses. Molecular identity and preclinical interest should remain distinct from demonstrated clinical outcomes. COVA offers this listing for laboratory research evaluation.
spec: Confirm nominal content, chemical form and independent report matched to the offered lot.
headline: Connective-tissue pathways
description: Rat tendon and ligament studies report repair-related findings. Cell studies examine migration, survival and tissue-response pathways.

name: TB-500
short: Thymosin-beta-4-related catalog product. Confirm the exact sequence before selecting a research material.
detail: TB-500 nomenclature varies across suppliers. Published analytical work has identified an acetylated thymosin-beta-4 fragment in material sold under this name. Full-length thymosin beta-4 and its fragments are different materials and should not share an assumed identity.
spec: Require sequence or molecular mass, chemical form, nominal content and a matching identity report. Do not assume full-length thymosin beta-4.
headline: Cell movement & remodeling
description: Thymosin-beta-4-related studies explore actin regulation and tissue remodeling. Confirm the sequence: fragments and full-length peptides differ.

name: KPV
short: Lys-Pro-Val tripeptide investigated in epithelial transport and inflammatory signaling models.
detail: KPV is a three-amino-acid peptide studied in laboratory models involving the PepT1 transporter and inflammatory responses. Its compact structure supports mechanistic research. Cell and animal findings do not establish a therapeutic claim for the supplied research material.
spec: Confirm peptide identity, nominal vial content and lot-specific purity documentation.
headline: Inflammatory balance
description: A tripeptide studied in epithelial transport and inflammatory signaling. Cell and mouse-colitis studies report anti-inflammatory effects.

name: Semax
short: Synthetic ACTH-related peptide studied in experimental neurotrophin signaling.
detail: Semax is an ACTH-related synthetic peptide investigated in neural research. Primary studies in rat models and cultured cells have examined BDNF-related responses. This context supports research identification rather than promises of improved cognition or neurological treatment.
spec: Confirm sequence, chemical form, nominal vial content and the tested lot identity.
headline: Neurotrophin signaling
description: An ACTH-related peptide investigated in experimental neurotrophin and nervous-system studies.

name: Selank
short: Synthetic tuftsin-related peptide investigated in experimental neurotransmission and gene-expression models.
detail: Selank is a synthetic peptide related to tuftsin. Experimental research includes studies of genes involved in GABAergic neurotransmission in cultured cells. Such findings do not establish relief of anxiety or other clinical outcomes for COVA research inventory.
spec: Confirm sequence, nominal content and lot-specific report. Keep human-use claims separate from laboratory descriptions.
headline: Neural signaling & stress
description: A tuftsin-related peptide studied in neurotransmission and gene-expression models, including experimental anxiety-related pathways.

name: Epithalon
short: Also called epitalon, a synthetic tetrapeptide investigated in gene regulation and telomere biology.
detail: Epithalon is commonly used as a catalog spelling for epitalon, the AEDG tetrapeptide. Cell-based research has explored gene-expression and telomere-related effects. These experimental observations do not demonstrate lifespan extension or rejuvenation in people.
spec: Match the epitalon identity and sequence to the label and report. Confirm nominal vial content.
headline: Cellular aging pathways
description: Also known as epitalon. A tetrapeptide investigated in gene regulation and telomere biology, largely in experimental models.

name: SS-31
short: Also known as elamipretide, a mitochondria-targeting peptide investigated in mitochondrial biology.
detail: SS-31 is a short synthetic peptide associated with mitochondrial membrane and bioenergetics research. Its molecular name also appears in drug-development literature. That literature does not establish authorization or clinical equivalence for a COVA research vial.
spec: Confirm elamipretide identity, chemical form and nominal vial content for the quoted lot.
headline: Mitochondrial function
description: Elamipretide targets mitochondrial cardiolipin. A specific prescription product has clinical evidence and an approved Barth syndrome indication.

name: Ipamorelin
short: Ghrelin-receptor agonist and growth hormone secretagogue for endocrine signaling research.
detail: Ipamorelin is a synthetic peptide investigated for growth hormone secretagogue activity. Its receptor profile makes it relevant to experimental endocrine studies. Research on a standalone compound does not establish the behavior of a blend containing it.
spec: Confirm identity and nominal content. Request standalone-lot documentation rather than relying on a blend report.
headline: Growth-hormone release
description: A ghrelin-receptor agonist and growth-hormone secretagogue studied in endocrine signaling.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
short: Also called thymalfasin, a peptide investigated in immune-cell signaling research.
detail: Thymosin alpha-1 is a synthetic version of a thymic peptide, also known as thymalfasin. Its research literature includes immune-cell signaling and modulation. This laboratory catalog does not claim infection prevention or treatment of immune disorders.
spec: Confirm thymalfasin identity, nominal vial content and lot-specific testing documentation.
headline: Immune-cell signaling
description: Also known as thymalfasin. Studies investigate immune-cell communication and responses in specific clinical and experimental contexts.

name: PT-141
short: Also known as bremelanotide, a melanocortin receptor agonist for receptor-signaling research.
detail: PT-141 is the research designation commonly associated with bremelanotide. It is relevant to studies of melanocortin receptor activity. COVA research supply is distinct from authorized prescription formulations and makes no sexual-health performance promise.
spec: Confirm bremelanotide identity, salt form and nominal content against the actual offered lot.
headline: Sexual-response pathways
description: Bremelanotide acts at melanocortin receptors. A prescription formulation has a specific indication for acquired, generalized HSDD in premenopausal women.
